entities.summary: Tamar Ariel (b. 1989-09-12, Masu'ot Yitzhak) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Masu'ot Yitzhak and Israel. Known in the fields of israel, military leaders & commanders, asia.
